name: net.haselab.netsim
displayName: NetSim - Multi-client Sync Test for VRChat Worlds
description: Editor-only sync test: runs several VRChat clients as copies of your world scene in one Unity Editor (ClientSim) and routes Udon networking (network events, synced variables, ownership, late join, master leave, object sync) through a simulated server with latency, jitter and loss. Use it from the NetSim window (Tools > NetSim), from C# scenarios or from the command line.

samples.description: A small world with correct sync patterns, planted sync bugs and a scenario that checks NetSim finds them.
A starting point for a scenario that knows your world.
